event.param3.$slot? and event.param3.$slot == (event.param3.$slot)i and event.param3.$slot ge 1 and global.$JKEOC_B371RouteSlots? and event.param3.$slot le global.$JKEOC_B371RouteSlots.count

set_value.name: global.$JKEOC_B380BatchToken

set_value.name: $open

set_value.name: $manualcount
set_value.exact: $manualcount + 1

set_value.name: $b.$message

set_value.name: $b.$message

set_value.name: $b.$message

raise_lua_event.name: 'JKEOC_SettingsMenu.batch.error'

do_if.value: event.param3.$token? and event.param3.$token == $b.$token and $b.$state == 'PREVIEW' and player.age - $b.$time le 5min and $b.$generation == global.$JKEOC_B371RouteGeneration and $b.$station.exists and $b.$station.owner == faction.player

set_value.name: $b.$deadline

set_value.name: $b.$message

set_value.name: $b.$message

raise_lua_event.name: 'JKEOC_SettingsMenu.batch.error'

set_value.name: global.$JKEOC_B380Batch.$message
set_value.exact: 'Remaining batch submissions cancelled by Clear Cases. Native orders were not cancelled.'

set_value.name: $role

set_value.name: $b.$message
set_value.exact: 'More than128 distinct issues. Complete set exceeds safety limit; nothing submitted.'
